title: packages/spec/src: 1,277 comment lines still cite 170 deleted tracker numbers (1,295 sites) — the staged remainder of ruling C+D on #19123, measured by PR #20226
body:
Filed as the carrier for the part of ruling `5749154545` (#19123, letter **C+D**, maintainer 「同意」) that its own text keeps out of one PR: 「The true clean-up scale … is the spec seat's to measure in the PR body, ⛔ not to sweep in one PR」. PR #20226 took that measurement and rewrote the five lines the ruling named. #19123 closes with it, so without this card the remainder has no carrier. Filed by `domain:spec` seat 4 (`session_01CiCTczDo7tGhafXjf61dUJ`, seat post #18917). ⛔ Not graded or routed here; ⛔ not a claim.

## The rule the lines break

`AGENTS.md` (`origin/main` `93cfc3f59`, lines 14–16): 「a rule's provenance cites the ADR or ruling record that decided it, otherwise the commit sha in this repository's history; a PR number is a convenience link, ⛔ never the citation.」 A citation that answers 404 fails that rule twice: it is a tracker number, and it has no target.

## The measurement (PR #20226's body; reproduced by that PR's at-tier review, record `5855923608`)

- **Instrument:** REST `issues/N` without following redirects, with lit and dead controls at nine checkpoints, plus the commit → PR association of squash suffixes. Over all **1,958** in-repo numbers cited in `packages/spec/src`, **172 are dead (8.8%)** and **0 answer 301**, so they were deleted, not moved. After #20226: **1,295 dead sites on 1,277 lines in 327 files, 170 numbers**.
- **Load-bearing share:** a seeded 40-line sample puts about **92%** of them as load-bearing: a ruling, a cautionary case or a deliberate tolerance, not a fixture placeholder.
- **Per-number table:** in PR #20226's body (sites and files per number). The review spot-checked eight numbers (all 404) and four site counts, all exact.

## Why it matters

The failure is silent. An agent that reads a dead citation beside a deliberate tolerance cannot tell 「kept on purpose by a ruling」 from 「nobody knows why」. #19123 records one measured incident of exactly that: a dev reported a gate it could run as NOT MEASURED. The decay continues; #19123 measured 11.7–15.1% of one week's merged-PR numbers gone.

## Form (already ruled, ⛔ not reopened)

Ruling C's order: the ADR or ruling record when one exists, else the commit sha in this repository, with a PR number allowed only beside it as a link. Each rewritten line says in its own words what the cited object decided (PR #20226 is the worked example). Anything an author is shown takes D (no number); for the migration-entry text specifically, see #20233.

## Staging (for triage and the lane, not a decision)

Area by area, each PR bounded and reviewable, the busiest areas first (PR #20226's body has the area table). ⛔ Not one PR.

Dedupe: `mcp__github__search_issues` (repo-scoped, semantic, closed included), `dead tracker number citations sweep packages/spec/src comments commit sha anchor` → 6 hits, 0 duplicates. #19123 is this card's parent; the other five are unrelated.

Dedupe words: `dead tracker citation sweep spec src` · `load-bearing citation 404 commit sha` · `ruling C+D staged sweep` · `provenance citation decay packages/spec`
